title: Generative Collapse Dynamics: Canon Placement and the Two-Axis Architecture — Why GCD Is the Highest-Level Theoretical Acronym Inside Structura Reditus
source_native_claims: GCD is not one subsystem among UMCP, RCFT, and ULRC; it is the foundational theory from which two necessary architectures follow: the tier architecture (authority) and the functional systems architecture (operation).
The two axes are orthogonal structures generated by the same theory; their formal separation does not extend GCD or add a new framework.
